title: item/v1
description: Envelope shared by every briefing source. `id` is `<source>:<extId>`, unique in the store and what agents cite. A content type adds the fields of its kind (`<kind>/v<N>`); the store validates each item against `<kind>/v1` when that schema exists. `matched` is set by the store (selector ids the item matches), never by a source.

title.description: Subject or headline; null when the kind has none.

container.description: Where it was fetched from (home, list:<id>, a folder).

labels.description: Every container, label or folder the item is known to be in (selector `in` matches these and container).
